spec_dod.text: Running `flyweight-mig migrate up` applies the pending migration adding `currency_code` to `invoices` and records it as applied.
Running `flyweight-mig migrate down` after that reverts the `currency_code` addition and the migration is recorded as un-applied again.
A migration that fails partway through is rolled back in full — `invoices` is left in its pre-migration state, not half-migrated.
Existing rows in `invoices` retain their original values for every column other than the new `currency_code` after the migration runs (no unrelated data drift).
The migration tool's dry-run preview gives an operator real confidence before running it for real against production.
